newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil weakens on crude, supply.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil weakens on crude, supply.

text.p: NWE low and high sulphur straight-run fuel oil was weaker on Friday as crude eased and amid slack demand, traders said.
A high sulphur E-4 cargo out of Klaipeda, with a relatively high water content, was heard to have been sold to a refiner at $93 cif NWE. Other cargoes were available.
A 6,000 tonne low sulphur straight-run cargo, containing around 0.4 percent sulphur, was sold to a Northern Irish buyer at the equivalent of $113 fob NWE.
